prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman seated.

a warm olive complexion, late 20s, Cleopatra, the queen of ancient Egypt, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other; every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass, the sheer weight of the flesh visible in how it spills forward and settles, her body so wide that her hips nearly touch the left and right edges of the frame; real photographic skin with visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, hair coloured a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends worn as many small bantu knots covering the scalp — full body polished blue amber resin fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid amber resin curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted amber sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep sea-blue amber surface with a golden glow across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID pale cyan swirls and tiny bubbles flowing through every section, with fine gold inlay lines tracing every joint between the sections, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: seated in a sturdy wooden armchair, leaning back with her legs stretched out in front of her — most extreme USSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: shoes of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, chunky block-heel pumps with a thick square heel in solid cobalt blue smooth polished leather, each with a very tall thick square block heel and a thick hidden platform under the toes, seated with her legs stretched impossibly long and extended out in front of her so the towering soles project into plain view.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each longer than her middle finger, made of the same amber with a high polish.
Jewelry: a gold belly chain with a small pendant at her navel, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT amber — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a clean bare face with natural eyes, opaque matte black lips with a precise edge.

Background: a bright art museum atrium with a pale stone floor, tall blank white walls, a wide staircase of standard steps and a normal-height doorway, strong rim backlight, silhouette definition, halo effect, cyberpunk glamour mood, futuristic neon atmosphere, dystopian editorial, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length EXTREME worm's-eye view shot with the camera placed on the floor at foot level and tilted steeply upward, the soles and heels huge in the foreground, her legs rising in exaggerated perspective and her head far above at the top of the frame, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her extreme height reads at a glance, the towering soles clearly in view. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
